gemini.rationale: The transaction creates a structural gap between T4 and T5 because the Sales JV (customer-facing) consolidates fully under Sauer-Danfoss, while the manufacturing operations (T5) remain in the Daikin-majority Manufacturing JV. This gap is mitigated at closing via a technology license and reciprocal distribution agreements. T6 is unverified in the slice, making gap_56 uncertain.

grok.rationale: At closing the Sales JV consolidates to 100% Company ownership while the Manufacturing JV 'will continue to manufacture and sell' the Existing Products and remains only 45%-Company-owned, so the customer-facing product/sales layer crosses without the producing processes moving under common ownership (gap_45=1). That split is bridged at closing by a technology license to the Manufacturing JV plus reciprocal non-exclusive distribution and off-take arrangements (gap_mitigated=yes). The 8-K describes no transfer or realignment of people, management, or culture, and the manufacturing processes themselves do not leave the Manufacturing JV, so no process-without-organization mismatch is documented (gap_56=0).

openai.rationale: The Sales JV consolidated under the Company, while the Manufacturing JV remained Daikin-majority and continued manufacturing and selling the Existing Products; therefore, the customer-facing sales/product layer crossed without the producing process moving under the same ownership control (SEC accession 0000865754-12-000051, Form 8-K Item 1.01). That product/process split was contractually bridged at closing through technology licensing, reciprocal non-exclusive distribution, and product off-take rights under the restructured agreement (same source). No transfer or re-engineering of operational processes without their associated organization or personnel is documented, so gap_56 is coded 0.
